summary: Performance refactor of secret listing (GET /api/v4/secrets and deprecated v3): cached glob matchers, cheaper permission checks, no per-row zod parse, fast-json-stringify response serializer, skip reference expansion for values without ${. Same permissions and output.

statements.why: Permission logic is equivalent (secret-v2-bridge-service.ts filter/mask rewrite and permission-fns.ts keep the same allow/deny/mask outcomes); serializer still drops unlisted fields; no data/auth change found.

statements.text: New server code that lists data and works without logging in. /zod
statements.why: /zod is a route defined only inside fastify-zod.test.ts on a throwaway Fastify instance; not an app address.

statements.text: New server code that lists data and works without logging in. /fast
statements.why: Test-only route in fastify-zod.test.ts; never registered in the real server.

statements.text: New server code that lists data and works without logging in. /fast-not-found
statements.why: Test-only route in fastify-zod.test.ts; never registered in the real server.

statements.text: There's now a maximum of 1,000 cached glob matchers.
statements.why: lib/casl/index.ts MAX_CACHED_GLOB_MATCHERS = 1000; internal perf cache, no behaviour change.

statements.text: A new package was added: fast-json-stringify (^7.1.3). Make sure you actually need it.
statements.why: Added in backend/package.json and used by fastJsonSerializerCompiler on the secrets list routes.

misses.what: The point of the change: listing secrets (API v3/v4 GET secrets, used by CLI/SDKs) should be faster and use less server memory; responses now go through a different JSON writer.
